newsitem.title: POLAND: GTE, TELIA BUY POLISH US WEST UNIT.
newsitem.headline: GTE, TELIA BUY POLISH US WEST UNIT.

text.p: U.S. company GTE Directories and Swedish telecom operator Telia bought US WEST Polska, a subsidiary of the US WEST International Inc., for an undisclosed sum GTE said on Friday.

"US West Polska, the largest phone directory publisher in Poland, was sold by US West International to the GTE and Telia," GTE said in a statement. It did not disclose the financial details of the transaction.
GTE said it would acquire 51 percent of US West Polska taking operational control over the company, Telia would take the remaining 49-percent stake.
The transaction has yet to be approved by Poland's Market Competition and Consumer Protection Office (UOKiK), the statement said.

US West International now intends to concentrate on cable and cellular telephone systems, its president Gary Ames said in the statement. The firm already earmarked 90 percent of its investments for the purpose, he added.
